I gotta say I always liked the color tint in FO3 and NV, felt like it added to the atmosphere and made the respective art styles come together. From what I've seen so far, FO4 seems almost a bit too bright and colorful for my taste, but I'll reserve judgement until I've actually played it. Of course I get that there are a lot of people that couldn't stand the tint, and the success of the mods that remove the filter speaks for itself.

That said, more games should just have a color saturation slider in the graphics options to satisfy both camps. I use my video card driver's tool to increase or decrease color saturation for certain games and it really does wonders to the general fidelity in some cases, I just wish the option would be native to more games.
